title: Fee bump whose inner path payment failed (over_sendmax): 200 charged of a 2000 bid, inner charged 10
why: The result is txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED wrapping the inner txFAILED[path_payment_strict_receive OVER_SENDMAX]; the outer fee source paid 200 of its 2000 bid and the inner result reports its own fee_charged of 10. Readers that read only the outer arm, take the bid as the fee, or index the failed payment as a movement report wrong values.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger (the Protocol 16 upgrade ledger, shared with cap-0033/p16-upgrade-strips-offer-sponsorship).

values.note: A failed transaction has no operation meta.

notes: Apply index 203 of 232; envelope tx_set.txs[92]. The fee source GDBNVR7C… is also the operation source and the payment's destination (a circular path through USDC and KTHOUSE), and the inner source GDW4TK6J… only has its sequence number bumped. The payment moved nothing, which the count 0 movement pins. Also demonstrates CAP-5: fee charged below the bid. Applied under Protocol 15 on the Protocol 16 upgrade ledger. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
